prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Edit target/reference: Esk turnaround. The same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Produce ONLY three separated head puppet parts in one horizontal row: FRONT, right-facing SIDE PROFILE, BACK. Preserve the tall pointed slate-blue hood flopping forward, grey scalloped wolf-fur ruff, brass round amber goggles pushed up on hood, three dark brown fringe locks, light skin, dot eyes, determined brows. Keep head scale consistent. CRITICAL neck fix: each complete head has a BROAD SOLID painted rust-red scarf/collar neck stub directly below chin/ruff, continuing WITHOUT ANY GAP down into torso. At final320px rig frame hat top y54, broad neck stub reaches y188 (20px below neck pivot168), about40px wide. Hood/head above roughlyy160, stub extends another28px underneath. Include no shoulders or torso, just head and broad attached collar stub. Back head also has same broad collar stub, no face. Neutral eyes open. True transparent background, no guides, no labels.
notes: Replacement front/side/back heads include broad rust scarf neck stub to y188, registered on unchanged rig.
